name.help:
Special Naming Guide: Use a name tag to name mobs. Add keywords in the name (can be combined):
nd: Invulnerable (takes no damage)
ned: Takes damage but cannot die
nbr: Remove Boss Bar (Wither only)
silent: Silent (no sounds)
nmove: Cannot move (still affected by water flow/gravity)
Example: Naming "nd nmove" makes the mob both invulnerable and immobile.

modslash.mods.help:
§a===== Function Mod Features =====
§e【Containers】
§7- Chests/Barrels/Shulker Boxes can be opened even with a block above
§7- Sneak + right-click a container with a name tag to rename/clear its name
§e【Enchantments】
§7- /demagic - Remove Curse of Binding/Vanishing from held item
§7- /removebinding <all|head|chest|legs|feet> - Remove binding curse equipment
§e【Special Name Tags】
§7- Name a mob with keywords: nd(invincible), ned(cannot die), nbr(hide boss bar), silent, nmove(no AI)
§7- /name - Show naming rules
§e【Teleportation】
§7- /home <name>, /sethome <name>, /delhome <name>, /homes
§7- /tpa <player>, /tpahere <player>, /tpaccept, /tpadeny
§7- /warp <name>, /setwarp <name>, /delwarp <name>, /warps
§7- /back - Return to previous location (death or teleport)
§e【World Features】
§7- Right-click harvests mature crops and replants automatically
§7- /treeauto <on|off> - Toggle auto tree replant
§e【Information Commands】
§7- /mods - Show this help
§7- /tps - Show server TPS
§7- /mspt - Show server MSPT
§7- /ping - Show your latency
§7- /nc [x] [z] - Convert overworld coords to nether
§7- /rct - Show repair cost of held item
§a===================================
